name: No Balls Allowed
summary:
No Balls Allowed is a chaotic marble race your Twitch chat plays live. Type !play and your marble drops onto the course with everyone else’s: pegs, spinners, portals, trapdoors, lava and a whole lot of bad decisions by gravity. You don’t steer. You don’t train. You just watch your little ball of hope bounce, get launched, get stuck and somehow win anyway.

Streamers add it to OBS as a single browser link, with no download and no install. Races are short and readable, the camera chases the drama for you, and close finishes drop into slow motion so the whole chat can scream at the same time. Run a series where points stack up and a champion gets crowned on the podium, or let chat bet pretend BallBucks on the Derby.
